fields.label: Business name
fields.guidance: Example: Rama Living

fields.label: What your business does
fields.guidance: Describe your offer and who it helps in two or three sentences.

fields.label: Who the website is for
fields.guidance: Example: People furnishing their first home.

fields.label: Main website goal
fields.guidance: Example: Browse products and prepare a WhatsApp shopping list.

fields.label: Services or categories
fields.guidance: Separate entries with commas. Example: Living room, Dining, Office

fields.label: Public email
fields.guidance: Only include an address you want visitors to see.

fields.label: Public phone or WhatsApp number
fields.guidance: Include country code. Example: +2547XXXXXXXX

fields.label: Visual style
fields.guidance: Choose: editorial, coastal or midnight. Leave blank for editorial.

fields.label: Brand colours
fields.guidance: Optional hex colours for background, text and buttons. Example: #F6F1E8

fields.label: Font direction
fields.guidance: Choose: serif, sans, modern or mono. Leave blank for serif.

fields.label: Logo image URL
fields.guidance: Optional public HTTPS image address. A text business name is fine.

fields.label: Website language and direction
fields.guidance: Example: English, left to right

fields.label: Pages in navigation order
fields.guidance: One per line: page ID | navigation name | address. Example: home | Home | index.html

fields.label: Home page ID
fields.guidance: Use an ID from the list above. Example: home

fields.label: Website summary
fields.guidance: A short description for search and sharing.

fields.label: Page ID
fields.guidance: Match a page ID from your navigation list. Example: home

fields.label: Page title for search
fields.guidance: Example: Rama Living | Furniture for Everyday Life

fields.label: Page description for search
fields.guidance: Explain what visitors can find on this page.

fields.label: Sections in display order
fields.guidance: List section IDs. Example: home-hero, home-services, home-faq

fields.label: Hero section ID
fields.guidance: Example: home-hero

fields.label: Hero heading
fields.guidance: Example: Make room for everyday living.

fields.label: Hero paragraph
fields.guidance: Write the exact introduction visitors should read.

fields.label: Hero button text and destination
fields.guidance: Example: Explore the collection | shop.html

fields.label: Hero image URL and description
fields.guidance: Optional HTTPS image URL | alternative text describing the image

fields.label: Page ID
fields.guidance: Which page contains this section? Example: home

fields.label: Section ID
fields.guidance: Unique within the website. Example: home-services

fields.label: Section type
fields.guidance: Choose: text, services, gallery, faq, shop, pricing, team, statistics, hours, contact or cta.

fields.label: Section heading
fields.guidance: Write the exact heading visitors should see.

fields.label: Section text
fields.guidance: Write the final copy. Use short paragraphs.

fields.label: Cards or repeated items
fields.guidance: One per line: title | description | optional price or value | optional destination

fields.label: Section button text and destination
fields.guidance: Optional. Example: Browse furniture | shop.html

fields.label: Shop page ID
fields.guidance: Example: shop. Repeat this record for every product.

fields.label: Product code
fields.guidance: A unique code. Example: RL-SOF-001

fields.label: Product name
fields.guidance: Example: Nia Sofa

fields.label: Category
fields.guidance: Example: Living room

fields.label: Product description
fields.guidance: Describe the product and what is included.

fields.label: Price and currency
fields.guidance: Numbers without thousands separators. Example: 48000 | KES

fields.label: Size and colour options
fields.guidance: Example: Size: Three-seater; Colour: Sand, Charcoal, Olive

fields.label: Availability
fields.guidance: Choose: available or unavailable.

fields.label: Product image URL and description
fields.guidance: Public HTTPS image URL | alternative text

fields.label: Gallery section ID
fields.guidance: Match a gallery section listed on a page. Example: room-gallery

fields.label: Gallery photos
fields.guidance: One per line: HTTPS image URL | alternative text | optional caption

fields.label: Photo credits and licence information
fields.guidance: One per line: image URL | creator | source page URL | licence

fields.label: FAQ section ID
fields.guidance: Match a faq section listed on a page. Example: home-faq

fields.label: Questions and answers
fields.guidance: One per line: question | answer. Use the final wording.

fields.label: Public location or service area
fields.guidance: Optional. Do not include a private home address.

fields.label: Opening hours
fields.guidance: One per line: day or day range | hours

fields.label: Public social links
fields.guidance: One per line: platform name | HTTPS profile URL

fields.label: Footer text
fields.guidance: Example: Rama Living. Furniture for everyday life.

fields.label: Business or demonstration notice
fields.guidance: Optional. Example: Fictional showroom. Products and prices are illustrative.

fields.label: Additional content notes
fields.guidance: Optional notes for a person reviewing the brief. These are not public page copy.
